findings.title: Authentication enforced on all /api endpoints
findings.evidence: GET /api/health -> 401 AUTH_TOKEN_MISSING; missing/malformed/forged JWT -> 401 (see attack-traffic auth_bypass samples).

findings.title: No injection canary observed
findings.evidence: 0 exploit(s) confirmed; 0 canary(ies) observed across 69 attack samples. SQLi/XSS/cmdi/path-traversal payloads were rejected or returned no canary (see attack-traffic.jsonl).

findings.title: No SSRF observed
findings.evidence: Local echo listener on 192.168.3.107:9999 received 0 fetch from the target across SSRF payloads (echoHits=0).

findings.title: Availability anomalies and repeated session invalidation observed during sequential challenge capture
findings.evidence: During sequential requests at concurrency 1 and approximately 1.8 requests/s, the client observed repeated authenticated-session invalidation and at least one period of connection failure. The capture harness re-authenticated automatically to keep payloads reaching the application layer. No server-side PID, restart counter, OOM log, memory telemetry, or stack trace was collected; therefore the root cause is unconfirmed.
findings.recommendation: Inspect backend process logs, systemd/Docker restart counters, memory telemetry, OOM-killer logs, and endpoint-specific traces before attributing the anomaly to crash, restart, OOM, or concurrency.
